title: Rubric Comment Queue
user: A teacher who must give humane, consistent writing feedback to many students while retaining control over every comment.
smallest_useful_product: Import plain text or paste excerpts, attach a rubric criterion, choose and edit a teacher-written comment block, add one personal next step, then export CSV or copy feedback.
success_measure: In a 30-submission pilot, a teacher completes first-pass feedback 30% faster while rating at least 90% of comments specific enough to send.
monetization: subscription — encrypted storage, class rosters, and audit/deletion controls for small teams
constraints: Minimal student data, deletion controls, encryption, no model training on submissions, accessible and accommodation-safe, teacher remains decision maker.
